content: Technical leadership of development teams, providing technical guidance, support in decision-making, and resolution of complex problems throughout the full project lifecycle.
Definition of scalable and maintainable software architectures, aligned with the company’s technical recommendations and the client’s real needs.
Establishment and application of development standards, best practices, and quality criteria based on principles such as Clean Code, SOLID, testing, continuous integration, and code review.
Direct collaboration with product teams, clients, and other stakeholders to understand requirements, define a clear technical vision, and translate functional needs into viable solutions.
Code review, technical support, and mentoring for other developers, fostering continuous improvement, team autonomy, and professional growth.
Evaluation of new technologies, tools, and approaches that may improve the efficiency, quality, and sustainability of the developed solutions.
Collaboration with other technical leaders and teams across the organisation to align architectural criteria, share knowledge, and strengthen a solid engineering culture.
Active participation in agile planning, review, and retrospective sessions, contributing to priority adjustment, process improvement, and value delivery.

I am Sergio Asensio, a Mathematics graduate from the University of Zaragoza, with more than 10 years of experience in software development and technology solutions and more than 4 years of experience in the water and environmental sector. Throughout my career, I have contributed to and led projects built with technologies such as Java, Angular, React, Salesforce, Flutter, Node.js, Python and ThingsBoard, working both independently and alongside highly skilled multidisciplinary teams.

As a technical leader, my experience covers a broad range of specialist knowledge in the development of web applications, mobile apps, data platforms and IoT solutions. My versatility is reflected in roles such as Full Stack Developer, Technical Architect, Solution Designer, and lead for database modelling and management, as well as in driving Docker-based containerisation and the adoption of CI/CD practices, with hands-on experience in cloud environments such as OpenShift, Azure and Heroku.

After entering the software development field in March 2016, I completed training in SAP (ABAP), Java and Salesforce, building the technical foundation that marked the start of my professional career.

During my early years at DxD Applications & IT Solutions, I worked on maintenance and development projects involving Salesforce, REST integrations, Node.js services deployed on Heroku, Java web applications, and ETL processes with Talend. This stage allowed me to grow both as a developer and in my understanding of architecture, integrations, and cloud deployment.

Later, at Grupo Oesía, I worked first as a developer and later as a technical analyst on projects related to waste management and public administration. There, I took on responsibilities in architecture, full stack development, team support, and knowledge transfer, while also single-handedly managing the maintenance and evolution of an application for Zaragoza City Council.

At UST Global, I worked as a Software Full Stack Senior Analyst Engineer, playing a key role in the development of a hospital software solution using Angular and Node.js. During this period, I further strengthened my expertise in front-end architecture, state management, back-end development, code review, and collaborative work within demanding teams.

Since November 2021, I have been working as a Technical Lead at Adasa, leading initiatives related to water, environment, telemetry, monitoring, meteorology, document management, and public administration. During this stage, I have defined and overseen architectures based on Angular, Node.js, TypeScript, Flutter, Python, ThingsBoard, PostgreSQL, Docker, GitLab CI, OpenShift, Azure Functions, and authentication systems such as Keycloak/LDAP, always with a focus on scalability, traceability, and maintainability.

Throughout my career, I have taken ownership of key responsibilities such as defining the core architecture of projects, creating reusable starter templates, developing reference modules, defining the data model, implementing Docker and CI/CD pipelines, producing technical manuals, deployment guides and methodological documentation, as well as creating internal video tutorials and training materials to strengthen team enablement and knowledge sharing.

I currently work as a Technical Lead with end-to-end responsibility across projects, covering everything from architecture definition to final delivery. I act as the main technical point of contact, lead development teams, make key design decisions, and ensure the successful execution of solutions in real-world environments.
